items.source: contracts/reviews/2026-11-23-continuity-audit.json and archives/runs/20261123T111109.190327Z-1927b151/test-report.json
items.observation: Local preflight accepted completion of the final unfinished owner of a previously registered major defect while the defect remained open. The original task and finding still existed, but ongoing work had no owner.

resolution.cause: The local ledger checked finding IDs and test ownership, but losing the final unfinished corrective task only produced a later status signal.
resolution.correction: Compare the prior and current owners before harness execution and in protected history. Require a transfer, verified resolution or deliberate deferral when the last unfinished owner retires.
resolution.prevention: A real temporary Git project finishes and removes its last owner, tests a valid transfer and an explicit deferral, and keeps intake available for a new defect discovered after earlier work finished.

items.source: contracts/reviews/2026-11-23-continuity-audit.json and a Git-launched local project preflight over two independent fixture repositories, archives/runs/20261123T112336.451128Z-4b84eb5b/test-report.json
items.observation: In one fixture repository an unsupported closure of a major finding failed local project validation. Invoking that same command through an external Git alias in another repository returned success and reported the other repository’s independently accepted checkpoint.

resolution.cause: Git-launched commands inherited the caller’s repository, index and object selectors while validating files in a second checkout.
resolution.correction: Resolve project history, source identity, check subprocesses, recovery and receipt provenance against the target checkout, clearing inherited repository-local Git selectors.
resolution.prevention: Use independent repositories and a registered worktree to verify both false acceptance and false rejection, the identity seen inside a check, and the archived receipt.

items.source: Independent review of the M0-082 hosted field staging and import path at 872f4b3 using synthetic records.
items.observation: A field record with synthetic screenshots could publish an unlisted action and its free-text description. The screenshot declaration alone also permitted publishing a device-local note in a required action without a sharing declaration for the text.

resolution.cause: The native publisher treated a synthetic screenshot declaration as sufficient for the entire record and accepted action names outside the versioned native action set.
resolution.correction: Require an explicit redacted text sharing declaration alongside synthetic screenshot scope. Check only declared hosted action names before reading values or screenshots and use a fixed diagnostic. Leave private annotations with their local record.
resolution.prevention: The synthetic regression runs local validation, native hosted validation, artifact staging and downloaded task import with unshared text in an expected action and with extra action names and contents. It verifies that none of the local-only data enters staged bytes or diagnostics and checks the packaged owner action boundary.

items.source: Independent review of M0-082 at 872f4b3 using a synthetic packaged owner observation dated in 2999.
items.observation: Local and hosted candidate verification accepted a future-dated owner review after the declared artifact digest was updated. The native field and installation checks likewise validated timezone syntax without checking whether the manual event had happened.

resolution.cause: The native and candidate consumers parsed timezone-aware observation times without comparing them with the verifier clock.
resolution.correction: Compare new manual observations with UTC at admission using a five-minute clock allowance. Validate native, packaged owner, Windows installation and supplied performance times with a fixed error for future observations.
resolution.prevention: Regression tests bind a far-future observation to an otherwise valid candidate and exercise local and hosted validation and staging. Native tests cover zoned times inside and beyond the allowance, immediate rejection before screenshot reads and independent verification of original historical diagnostic bytes.

items.source: The final protected c161317 history comparison with audit base bea74a5 and the clean verification preflight at archives/recovery/20261123T132416.954560Z-23b9430d/diagnostic.json.
items.observation: The five-merge audit rejected the accepted cookie dependency correction for lacking a receipt field introduced by a later protected merge. Other earlier bases rejected the release-profile and CSV corrections under the same check. Each affected task retains its original regression receipts.

resolution.cause: A history comparison treated all changes since its base as new closures governed by observation-bound receipts. It did not distinguish records accepted under the preceding policy.
resolution.correction: Verify the actual protected introduction and its first-parent ledger when the comparison crosses the transition. Preserve earlier task definitions and ordered receipt prefixes while validating each later checkpoint independently.
resolution.prevention: The Python suite builds real Git merges and tests long reviews, two independent checkpoints in either order, altered observations, recurrences, dropped original receipts, candidate ref replacements, missing ancestry and a verifiable relocation of the same diagnostic. The dated audit retains the original failing range and official receipts.

items.source: Owner hands-on feedback after following the M2-014 prototype walkthrough on 2026-11-23, with follow-up in contracts/reviews/2026-11-23-workbench-authoring-direction.json.
items.observation: The owner could follow the demonstrated steps but could not decide what information to see. The reviewed prototype fixes the synthetic closes and admits only threshold tiles and a value table. Its successful walkthrough demonstrates editing and recovery; it does not establish independent composition. In the follow-up on 2026-11-23 the owner clarified that the embedded product AI must author the actual original view from user intent and structurally revise bindings, presentation and permitted interactions. Manual field selection, arranging predefined widgets and routing phrases to fixed templates do not meet that requirement.

items.observation: The global icon rule fixes all SVG heights at 19 CSS pixels. The drawing surface overrides width only, producing an 861.109375 by 19 viewport and compressing the two close centers to 43.70 pixels apart horizontally and 4.86 vertically. Logical coordinate checks passed while the native picture was unreadable.

resolution.cause: The global SVG icon height overrode the drawing's intrinsic aspect ratio.
resolution.correction: Set the drawing surface height to auto with the declared logical aspect ratio.
resolution.prevention: Measure actual screen geometry in two browser sizes, and check the same window sizes on WebKitGTK. Retain the original frozen preview and screenshot.
